verdict.rationale: Skyfire's docs site serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200, agent-oriented summary) confirmed by both a probe and a runtime check, and its full docs are structured as agent-consumable markdown (.md endpoints throughout). This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent successfully consuming llms.txt end-to-end, and no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404) which would further strengthen machine-readability.
